superwing-load-low-cl015.objective: maximise the geometric mean of lift-to-drag across the three flight conditions, for a wing whose evaluation completes at the target lift
superwing-load-low-cl015.score_rule: an aggregate score exists only when all three conditions converge and trim at the target lift; an incomplete profile has no score
